title: Monthly strategy snapshot and executive asks (compact)
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Purpose: Produce a concise (2-page) strategy snapshot to brief execs at the monthly leadership sync. Focus on 3 signal areas: customer-facing latency/cost trends, Dedicated capacity commitments, and Private deployment pipeline health. Deliverable includes a single-slide asks page with precise decisions and resource requests. Audience: CEO, CTO, Head of Sales, Head of Ops.
progress_updates: 2026-03-03 - Initial outline drafted and shared with Eng Leads for metrics coverage.
2026-03-05 - Data pull complete: latency P50/P95 by model, 90-day cost per 1M tokens trend, Dedicated capacity utilization by customer cohort.
2026-03-07 - First draft slide deck reviewed by PM peer; suggested reduce technical detail to one appendix slide.
2026-03-09 - Incorporated finance cost modeling for committed vs. on-demand Dedicated; added contingency asks.
2026-03-10 - Circulated to executive sponsor for pre-read.
decision_points: Approve an incremental $250k monthly commit for Dedicated capacity to support 10% QoS SLAs for top 12 accounts.
Greenlight accelerated rollout of Private 1.1 (VPC installer) to 3 pilot customers with a contingency window for security review.
Confirm priority ordering for the next quarter among runtime perf workstreams: KV cache improvements, kernel switcher, and batching scheduler.
asks: Approve $250k/month committed Dedicated capacity for Q2-Q3 to reduce throttling risk for high-usage customers.
Authorize 2 additional SRE contractor months to support the Private deployment pilot (budget request attached).
Enable go/no-go on enabling the aggressive batching profile for non-interactive embeddings workload (requires temporary soft-SLO on tail latency).
initiative_health: Runtime performance: yellow - P50 stable, P95 elevated after model mix shift; root cause tracked to long-tail sequence batches.
Dedicated: green - utilization at 78% for committed pools; two renewal conversations in progress with top customers.
Private: yellow - installer stability improved; pilot onboarding rate slower than forecast due to customer network constraints.
metrics_snapshot: Cost per 1M tokens (hosted generation mix): $38.4 — trending +6% vs prior 30 days
Private pilot funnel: 9 qualified leads, 3 active installs, expected +2 installs/mo with current runbook
risks: If Dedicated commit not approved, risk of intermittent throttling for top accounts leading to churn (estimated ARR exposure $1.2M over 12 months).
Enabling aggressive batching for embeddings could increase P95 by ~25ms for interactive customers unless KV cache rules are tightened.
Private pilot is dependent on customer firewall rules; delays here will push private revenue recognition into a later quarter.
next_steps: Finalize 2-page exec brief and one-slide asks by 2026-03-12.
Schedule 30-min leadership sync slot and pre-read distribution to execs on 2026-03-13.
If commit approved, ops to issue purchase order and Eng to schedule Dedicated pool scaling events for week of 2026-03-24.
acceptance_criteria: Exec brief is <=2 pages and includes top-line metrics, three initiative health signals, and a single ask slide.
Finance has validated cost model and committed spend numbers.
Executive sponsor confirms meeting time and pre-read distribution.
